CI_scope: Pointwise 95% intervals, no multiplicity adjustment. A CI wholly inside the preregistered [-3%,+3%] band is practical timing equivalence; all others stay uncertain. This is not a new layout-performance claim or permission for result-dependent reruns.

bitwise_summary.scope: Independent whole backward reruns may have different partial accumulation order; fixed-input and same-produced-partial merge comparisons require byte equality.

estimator: mean of 3 workers x 5 visit medians; paired worker/visit hierarchical bootstrap 4096
relative_change_definition: 100*(G0/U-1): negative means G0 faster; positive means G0 slower
